common_fields.name: company_id
common_fields.note: business entity (empresa), not tenant; immutable after create

common_fields.name: code
common_fields.note: user code; never derived from PII

common_fields.name: node_type
common_fields.note: AGRUPADOR = non-posting group node; DETALLE = posting leaf

common_fields.name: parent_id
common_fields.note: must be an AGRUPADOR of the same company and dimension; null = root

rules.rule: Only DETALLE nodes may be referenced by journal lines or document lines; AGRUPADOR references are rejected (422 dimension_node_not_postable).
Single parent per node (strict tree, not a DAG); no cycles; parent must be AGRUPADOR, same company, same dimension; a DETALLE cannot have children.
Maximum depth configurable per company and dimension (default 6, bounds 1..10); deeper inserts or re-parents are rejected.
Company scope enforced by composite foreign keys (company_id, id): a line in company A can never reference a node of company B; the same code may exist in different companies.

A node referenced by any posted line cannot be deleted, cannot change node_type, and cannot change company; it can be archived (blocks new references after valid_to/archive) and its description edited (audited).

Re-parenting is allowed only to a valid AGRUPADOR and is audited; posted lines keep the leaf id (never rewritten). Reports group by the hierarchy as of a chosen date using an effective-dated closure table (node, ancestor, depth, valid_from, valid_to); default = current hierarchy, option = hierarchy as of period end. Historical numbers never change, only their grouping.

Aggregation over a group = sum over its descendant leaves via the closure table; each leaf counted once (no double counting when a group and its child are both selected: the filter resolves to the leaf set).

Per company, the rule matrix decides allowed/required/forbidden per dimension × (account or account range, document type, concept, journal); PostingService validates it in the same transaction (shared check with `requires_dimensions[]`); preview/simulate returns the same errors.
Dimension values never change amounts; postings, balances and invariants are identical with or without dimension values; ledger_balance dims_hash includes the two new slots.
Row and field policy (P04) apply to the masters and to the slots on lines in API, UI, search, export, reports, AI and MCP; no new bypass.

Import/export round-trip is non-lossy: parents may appear after children in the file (two-pass resolution by code), cycles and cross-company parents are rejected atomically, re-import of an export is a no-op.

Distinctness: 'Item' here is an accounting analytical dimension (item_dimension_id), not the inventory product (inventory.Item) and not the PUC account; 'Auxiliar Abierto' is a user-defined analytical code (aux_abierto_id), not the general-ledger auxiliary report and not AR/AP open items.

dimensions.meaning_note: Cost center (centro de costo). Promoted in 2.2.0-dev to the same master invariants; replaces the P04 `CostCenter` entity (P04 keeps role scopes referencing it).
Business unit (unidad de negocio); new mandatory master in 2.2.0-dev; a branch may declare a default business unit (D-030).
User-defined open analytical code (e.g. project, contract, campaign, fund) attached to accounting lines. Interpretation accepted by the user (2.2.0-dev); the model is generic.
User-defined accounting analysis item (e.g. budget or expense line), distinct from inventory products and PUC accounts. Interpretation accepted by the user (2.2.0-dev).
